text:
A: Hiya, erm, sorry, can you hear me?
B: Yeah. Hello.
A: I'm Holly. Stockport.
B: Shazia. Blackburn.
A: Oh, we're quite close! Erm, sorry, I have to say, I love the throw on your settee. Did you make it?
B: No. My aunty. She does them for everyone.
A: Aw, it's lovely. I'm trying to learn crochet, but I've had one half-finished in a bag since, like, the summer.
B: She'd teach you. She teaches all my nieces. They don't finish them neither.
A: Haha, that makes me feel better. Have you got loads of nieces?
B: Four. And two nephews.
A: That's loads. Erm, sorry, do you work? Everyone's asked that, sorry.
B: It's alright. No. My back. I was packing, nights.
A: Oh, nights would kill me. I'm on days and I still fall asleep on the train home. I'm an apprentice in a lab, so testing samples and that.
B: My niece wants to do science. She's fifteen. Her mum wants her to be a doctor.
A: Oh, tell her about apprenticeships! Sorry, I don't mean to be pushy. It's just, I didn't want uni debt, and you get paid, and you can still do a degree after. And it's not as scary as it sounds, the people are really nice, and if you mess up you just say and redo it, nobody shouts at you. I don't know if that makes sense.
B: It does. I'll tell her. Her mum won't listen, mind.
A: Haha. Mums.
B: Mm.
A: Erm. What do you do in the evenings, then?
B: Dramas. Pakistani ones, on YouTube.
A: Are they sad? I cry at everything. I cried at Bake Off last week because someone's cake collapsed.
B: Some are sad. The one now, the mother-in-law is horrible. The girl cries every episode. I cry as well sometimes.
A: See, I'd be the same. I can't watch anything where a dog dies. I've got an old dog, Bonnie, she's asleep next to me now.
B: What kind?
A: Staffy cross. She's fourteen, so she's an old lady.
B: My nieces want a dog. My brother says no.
A: Aw. Erm, sorry, random, but what are you having for tea?
B: Chicken saalan. Later, when Imran's in.
A: That sounds so nice. My mum said fajitas, I think. I can do fajitas. That's about all I can do, do you know what I mean, haha.
B: Fajitas is alright. Easy.
A: Yeah. I keep saying I'll learn to cook properly before I move out, but I don't even know when that's...
